name: Airtable
description: Airtable is a cloud platform that combines a relational database with spreadsheet-like views, letting teams build custom apps, automations, and interfaces on top of their own data without traditional coding.
best_for: Positioned for teams in product, marketing, project management, operations, sales, design, HR, and finance who want to move off spreadsheets toward custom interfaces and automations.
features: Relational database foundation shared across a team
Multiple customizable views for the same underlying data
Interface Designer for building custom drag-and-drop apps
